verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an accounting platform, but the evidence shows no user-configurable recurring workflow scheduler. The 'schedules' in the Agentic Close are depreciation and accrual schedules, not job scheduling. Continuous auto-booking and real-time reconciliation are always-on vendor automation, not user-defined recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
